text:
[issue by Arc149]
### Describe the bug

AE2 version is 19.2.18,Kaleidoscope Cookery is 1.6.0,Minecraft is 1.21.1 neoforge 21.1.250.When I want let the ore in the ME Interface use ME Storage Bus to the millstone sometime will make a bug,if I take in ME Interface is more 8(8 is millstone's max capacity),so the bug will come,in  the ME Interface ore will keep a same number,if I take number is  at 8 lower the bug  will not have.

### How to reproduce the bug

When I want let the ore in the ME Interface use ME Storage Bus to the millstone sometime will make a bug,if I take in ME Interface is more 8(8 is millstone's max capacity),so the bug will come,in  the ME Interface ore will keep a same number,if I take number is  at 8 lower the bug  will not have.

### Expected behavior

I think the  ME Interface and ME Storage Bus should be striter,the buug will cause inflation.

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

[comment by shartte (member)]
This is due to that mod incorrectly implementing the simulation insert for their millstone item handler (it returns that we can fully insert 9 items, but then when you actually commit, it only accepts 8).
